name: API Fetcher
description: Generic identifier-driven structured-API fetcher. Per-entity lookups against configured APIs (JSON + XML/RSS), multi-endpoint chaining, field mapping, raw-text flattening. Adding an API source = JSON config, not code.
usage_notes: Enriches entities from structured APIs keyed by an identifier (a channel id, feed URL, or registry number). Identifiers come from an entity seed column (Step 0) or a Step-1 pool-item field, so this Step-3 module is empty_ok (runs without prior URLs). Configure at least one provider (JSON config; see README for schemas and ready-made blocks). ALL provider knowledge — endpoints, params, field maps, auth, RSS tag names — is template configuration; no vertical is baked into code or defaults. providers: [] default is a loud no-op.

options.name: providers
options.label: API Providers
options.description: Array of provider config objects: id, name, response_format (json|xml), identifier_source ({entity_field, item_field}), optional auth, and endpoints[] (url, params, results_path, field_map, optional url_template / raw_text_template). Endpoints run in order; {identifier}, {max_items}, {endpoint_id.field} chain responses. No providers = loud no-op. See README for schema and examples.

options.name: provider_params
options.label: Provider parameters
options.description: Extra query params per provider id, merged into every endpoint request. E.g. {"companies-house": {"items_per_page": "20"}}.

options.name: max_items
options.label: Max items per list endpoint
options.description: Cap on records kept per endpoint (videos, episodes, filings). Also substituted into params via the {max_items} placeholder. Quota guard.

options.name: requests_per_minute
options.label: Rate limit (requests/min)
options.description: Global token-bucket rate limit across all providers, entities, and endpoints.

options.name: raw_text_max_chars
options.label: Raw text max characters
options.description: Truncate the flattened raw_text per item to this length (downstream Step 5 input size guard).

options.name: skip_providers_without_auth
options.label: Skip providers with missing credentials
options.description: When a provider declares auth with an env var that is not set, skip it with a warning (true) rather than calling the API unauthenticated (false).
